title: Social Security Act (Luật An sinh Xã hội)

versions.text:
Social Security Act (42 USC §301 et seq.).
Title II: Federal Old-Age, Survivors, and Disability Insurance (OASDI). §202: Old-age benefits. §223: Disability insurance benefits. Full retirement age: 66-67 (depending on birth year). Funding: FICA tax (6.2% employer + 6.2% employee on wages up to $168,600 in 2024).
Title XVIII: Medicare. Part A: Hospital insurance. Part B: Supplementary medical insurance. Part C: Medicare Advantage. Part D: Prescription drug benefit.
Title XIX: Medicaid.
